source.title: Forebears Togo forenames and surnames frequency tables

names.notes: Public frequency tables were used to seed localized names. Gender buckets are conservative review samples based on common Togolese forenames, not an official civil registry extract; surnames are from the public Togo surname frequency table.

source.title: ITU Togo national numbering plan communication of 11.I.2021

phones.notes: ITU/ARCEP confirms country code +228, fixed eight-digit national significant numbers, and the listed mobile allocations for Togo Cellulaire and Atlantique Telecom Togo. Generated numbers are synthetic and are not checked for current subscriber assignment or portability.

locations.notes: UPU's Togo example uses B.P. addressing and locality/country lines rather than a postcode. The generator uses BP-style prefixes; region/city mapping follows public geography and generated box/street values are synthetic review data.
